title: Evaluating Named Entity Recognition: A Comparative Analysis of Mono- and Multilingual Transformer Models on a Novel Brazilian Corporate Earnings Call Transcripts Dataset
reasoning: The paper is a technical and performance-oriented study of Named Entity Recognition (NER) systems within the financial domain for Brazilian Portuguese. It focuses on dataset creation (BraFiNER) and model evaluation using accuracy metrics; it does not explore or benchmark religious, spiritual, moral, or ethical dimensions.
